<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="dhTei78DZyLTjWWdzUyG"> <mxGraphModel dx="3930" dy="3485" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 subgraph Data Sources
 direction LR
 val[\"player_valuations.csv<br>(valuation history)\"]
 style val fill:#bbf,stroke:#333
 cyl_val[( )]
 val --- cyl_val
 
 ply[\"players.csv<br>(demographics)\"]
 style ply fill:#bbf,stroke:#333
 cyl_ply[( )]
 ply --- cyl_ply

 app[\"appearances.csv<br>(match-level stats)\"]
 style app fill:#bbf,stroke:#333
 cyl_app[( )]
 app --- cyl_app
 end

 subgraph Processing
 t1[\"Sort by date → keep latest valuation<br>per player (target: market_value)\"]
 t2[\"Drop unused columns<br>(names, URLs, agent, city…)\"]
 t3[\"Group by player_id: sum goals, assists, minutes;<br>count matches_played\"]

 val --> t1
 ply --> t2
 app --> t3

 merge[\"Merge on player_id (left join)\"]
 t1 --> merge
 t2 --> merge
 t3 --> merge

 fe[\"Feature engineering: age ← date_of_birth;<br>contract_years_left ← contract_expiration_date (clip ≥ 0);<br>goals_per_match, assists_per_match\"]
 merge --> fe

 clean[\"Cleaning: drop rows missing DOB/height;<br>replace inf → NaN → fill 0;<br>leakage check: market_value not in X\"]
 fe --> clean

 ohe[\"One-hot encode position, foot (drop_first)<br>→ 12 input features\"]
 clean --> ohe

 split[\"Train/test split 80/20, random_state = 42\"]
 ohe --> split
 end

 subgraph Models
 direction LR
 lr[\"Linear Regression<br>Test R² ≈ 0.22\"]
 style lr fill:#ffdfba,stroke:#333
 
 rf[\"Random Forest (max_depth=10)<br>Test R² ≈ 0.59\"]
 style rf fill:#ffdfba,stroke:#333
 
 xgb[\"XGBoost (300 trees, lr=0.05, depth=4)<br>Test R² ≈ 0.65\"]
 style xgb fill:#ffdfba,stroke:#333
 end

 split --> lr
 split --> rf
 split --> xgb

 eval[\"Evaluate on test set (MAE, R²)\"]
 style eval fill:#e0e0e0,stroke:#333
 lr --> eval
 rf --> eval
 xgb --> eval

 dec{\"Best R²?\"}
 style dec fill:#e1d5e7,stroke:#333
 eval --> dec

 save[\"Save XGBoost: xgb.save_model('model.json')\"]
 style save fill:#ffdfba,stroke:#333
 dec -->|XGBoost| save

 class val,ply,app default;
 class t1,t2,t3,merge,fe,clean,ohe,split default;
 class eval default;",
 "config": null
